{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0.0) or shows recent negative momentum.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp upward spikes by applying a 1-2 day lag correction.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 5% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 10-15%.",
    "Increase downward bias when true outcome is consistently below 30-day moving average.",
    "If sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.5), slightly increase forecast to reflect bullish momentum.",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, apply a 10-15% downward adjustment if historical error shows overestimation in 30%+ of cases.",
    "When sentiment is neutral (0.0–0.33), use 30-day moving average as baseline with ±5% volatility buffer."
  ]
}
